exceptions.why: Modern thumbnail reads use rawProps.data() when YouTube's data property is a Symbol placeholder; the shared live-read port also probes the accessor.
The Music page bundle includes the shared live-read port, including the modern thumbnail accessor support used on YouTube.
Thumbnail overlays track page pointer, mouse and drag gestures so they cannot intercept the release that ends queue reordering.
The in-page Save picker now includes its own control utilities and a small shadow-root reset so YouTube's styles and 10px root cannot leave controls unstyled or shrink the text.
Feature selection includes localized examples and a loader for the illustrated previews. The illustration component is a separate lazy chunk.
The upgrade entry shares the first-run shell, including the localized example captions and lazy preview loader.
